content.title: How to Watch the 2026 Masters
content.text: Hey, golf fans. It’s the second week of April and that can mean only one thing:The Masters is here!The 90th Masters Tournament is set to tee off at iconic Augusta National Golf Club, officially kicking off the Major Championship season in style. From roars on Sunday to the magic of the Par 3 Contest, it’s all happening this week.See the schedule below for the latest broadcast and streaming details (all times Eastern, live stream times are approximations and subscriptions may be needed for some streams)Masters Live streamNote: *Paramount+ login required.
